Unreal Engine 4.15 Released (improved Linux build support)

Here is a list of things regarding Linux for this release.

New/additions:

  • Added support for ARM64 (AArch64) devices running Linux! Note that any such devices must have support for desktop OpenGL 3.2 or later to run the engine.
  • Added architecture hash to path for generated includes on Linux Installed Build.
  • It is now possible to launch your project on a remote Linux machine from the editor or UFE.
  • Updated bundled libc++ to 3.9.
  • DSOs can specify the mode (RTLD_GLOBAL/LOCAL) with which the engine will open them.
  • Added support for touch events (e.g. from a touchscreen).
  • Server will now crash the hung thread with SIGQUIT.
  • The engine will default to OpenGL 4.x code path on Linux unless -opengl3 is passed on command line.
  • All Linux targets will use binned malloc by default (previously some would use jemalloc).
  • Linux architecture (x86_64, ARM, etc) can now be set per project.
  • Added CEF support on Linux (x86_64 only).
  • Added pre-built websockets library for Linux.
  • Added verbose printout whenever GL context's vblanc sync is being configured.
  • Linux remote devices added in editor's device manager will now be saved in Project Settings.
  • Linux touch events are filtered to prevent multiple OnTouchMoved events with the same location.
  • Added build-essential to dependencies installed by Setup.sh so the engine can be built on Windows 10 Ubuntu subsystem.

Bugfixes:

  • Fixed support for the Optimize Code setting on Mac, HTML5, Android, Linux, iOS, and Xbox One. This controls optimization level in Debug Game configurations.
  • Fixed issues with Mac and Linux install and uninstall scripts if ANDROID_HOME not set.
  • Fixed a crash when editing Skeletal Meshes on Linux.
  • Fixed a crash on exit due to unsafe use of virtual functions in FRunnableThreadLinux.
  • Fixed long-standing GL crash when using vertex attrib binding.
  • Fixed a crash when opening Project Settings on Linux.
  • The engine will not refuse to start as root on platforms other than x86_64 (e.g. ARM).
  • Projects are now properly associated with the engine version or installation.
  • Fixed GL4 rendering issues with tessellation.
  • Fixed remote deploying of a packaged build to Linux.
  • Fixed launch on a remote Linux machine.
  • Fixed an issue for determining installed Linux cross-toolchain.
  • Use response files for ar (fixes cross-compilation failing due to too long command lines).

Other items/improvements:

  • 4.15 will compile with clang 3.9.x with fewer suppressed warnings.
  • Disabled XGE when cross-compiling on Windows again (does not work well with clang 3.9).
  • Updated code which determines number of cores to produce the correct result on ARM boards.
  • Test configuration will drop core by default.
  • Removed hard-coded paths to mono binary and replaced it with a script.
  • “always_inline” is no longer applied to FORCEINLINE functions in debug builds.
  • Speed up bForceCompilationAtStartup=True when nothing changed.
  • Remove forced -windowed when launching from the editor.
  • Bootstrap script is now independent of the working directory and can be started via symlink.
  • Large mouse movement workaround will not be applied if the application has only one window.
  • SDL audio subsystem will no longer be initialized (it is not used anyway).
